jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Position Overview The Vice President, Product helps raise the quality, speed, and ambition of product development across the Cordance portfolio. This is not a traditional single-company VP of Product role. The VP partners with BU Presidents, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to strengthen product strategy, improve the quality of major product bets, and help our businesses build products that drive growth, retention, and long-term value. The mandate spans executive advisory work on major product decisions, raising product capability and craft across the portfolio, and helping teams use AI to rethink both what they build and how they build it. Success in this role means our businesses make better product choices, validate ideas earlier, build faster, and put more of their product and engineering capacity behind the opportunities most likely to improve customer value and business performance. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role. Make the value case tangible  for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand. Take it live.  Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live. Own adoption, not just delivery.  A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project. Document what you built  — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover. Work across disciplines : with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer s ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines. This role is ideal for someone who can work across teams with empathy, build trust with a wide range of partners, and move work forward in a practical, low-ego way. You will join a small product team, and work closely with engineering, security, legal, sales and customers, including our first enterprise pilots. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. jobs.title: Data Migration Project Manager
jobs.description: À propos de Dastra Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA . Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle , en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises. Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover , en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables . Le rôle En tant que Data Migration Project Manager , tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison. À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client , ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %) , tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.
